source: Kandal Provincial Department of Agriculture (មន្ទីរកសិកម្មខេត្តកណ្តាល), "ដំណំពោត" (Corn Crop / Zea mays production manual), 2015
text:
Storing seed corn: select good-quality sacks for storing seed corn, appropriate for the variety, so the seed is not lost/wasted and does not become damaged or moldy. Characteristics required: seed must be free of disease and free of insect infestation, and both the corn seed itself and the storage sack should be of good quality; select sacks that are strong/durable and that are not torn or broken.

Seed stored in sacks should have a moisture content of about 13% -- storing seed at this moisture level helps prevent it from becoming rancid/deteriorated or moldy, and helps preserve the quality of seed intended for planting, by keeping seed dry and stored in clean, insect-free storage sacks.
